column1: # a compressed float's declared [min, max] is the writer's contract, and the
# fixed-form save refuses a value outside it before it writes a byte (the Go
# reference engine answers invalid_value; a leg whose write-side checks refuse
# in every build refuses by its own spelling of the same verdict). A value
# inside it, the bounds included, is written. Probe.schema is the unit.
# Each row: load base.json, then set <path> to <value> IN THE NATIVE VALUE,
# after the load, so no reader clamps or refuses it first; save the fixed form
# of <root>. <expect> is `refused`, or the stem of the bytes owed,
# TestCompressedRangeWriteCorpus pins as the Go reference engine's encoding of
# The plain row is the CONTROL: p declares no range, so a value no compressed
# field admits is written, and a writer that range-checked every float fails it.
# A path is a field, `field[index]` for an array element, `field[Variant]` for
# an enum-keyed slot, or `field.arm` for a union's set arm.
